Inside AI Code Limitations, the posts are arguing one position rather than a stack of unrelated claims.

representative_posts.author: yoshils.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm also late to this one but thank GOD I didn't buy any of the Kingdom Hearts stuff for Fortnite and haven't played in so long. Another shitty greedy company using AI and fired real people. They even said some stupid bullshit too. I'm telling you, Gaming is DYING.

representative_posts.text: gaming just isn’t very interesting right now it’s not bad (well, arguably it is bad) because the games releasing are fun but it’s just not very interesting. representative_posts.author: bitchstupid.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: it sucks that gaming is so reactionary on all sides and aren't ready for nuanced topics like how it actually is ok to be frustrated with critics who engage with what they're reviewing in blatantly bad faith and that is not just "being a hardcore gamer" or "Gatekeeping"

representative_posts.author: bladerlbm2.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Its easy to forget because we isolate in this bubble of other people that have bought into it. But 40 years of gaming history does not even register as a real choice for play in the head of everyone outside this space, from your coworker to your hipster friend

representative_posts.author: takel.gryph.one
representative_posts.text: I'm pretty sure the cloud gaming thing affects approximately 0% of Xbox owners, but the fact that people are making the conflations they are is still probably not good from a branding perspective

representative_posts.author: arrowsmorgan.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: i kind of bristle at the people still trying to fight the battle over this game being Bad Queer Rep etc based on the ads because. in practice. it's actually really really good about it. to a fucking shocking degree for a AAA game, where it has some of my favorite queer characters in all of gaming.

representative_posts.author: 96aka.bsky.social

perspectives.title: Managers Fail

representative_posts.author: sockcouncil.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It'll be a disaster, he's a Moyes like mid table manager at best. Has one plan, can't deviate. Not sure the players will enjoy Tindall etc, nor the fans. They are used to a different quality at Old Trafford.

representative_posts.author: rhyswl.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If he was going into a Brighton or a Brentford then he'd have more of a chance. We haven't got that side of it sorted yet so there is a lot more responsibility for a manager to get it right on the pitch with much higher expectations

representative_posts.author: sbienkowski.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Not much point appointing a new manager ahead of Chelsea (A), Roma (H), Aston Villa (H) and Liverpool (A). Let Carrick take the fall and then begin the rebuild ahead of January.

representative_posts.author: a1957.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Problem with appointing ex players as Man Utd appear to do every so often is they are doing so based on the their playing career and not them as managers. Carrick has no gravitas and nor did Solskjaer. He “knows Man Utd” seems to be the owners criteria. Not enough. Not anywhere near enough.

representative_posts.author: percytoplis.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If I had to bet on a new manager Howe 70%, desperate and free Nagelsman 20%, shows "ambition", but we all know hes a total fraud A N Other 10%

representative_posts.author: cvbragg.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I really enjoyed Howe's football at Bournemouth. Wouldn't have minded him back then. But you are right about his inability to adapt. I thought he'd be a better manager than he has turned out to be. Also Tindall is absolutely one of the least likeable people in football.

representative_posts.author: ilpenseroso.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: How on earth is anyone listening to this no-mark? Carrick -whatever you think of him - has been at the dnd of more than a decade of inept corporate management, incontinent spending, and now he wants a manager who has won one trophy. Because he’ll be cheaper. Wow.

representative_posts.author: blueskiesecho.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Regardless of the pumping we’ll no doubt get, losing one of our best players before kickoff & having to bring in a youth player is a big blow. But it is what it is. Manager needs time, & I expect nothing from this game or the next few. We need patience & perspective. Always Hibernian! 💚 #Persevere

representative_posts.author: ticgran45.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Exactly . He's probably knackered . Every player need a wee rest now and again. Especially if have players to cover for them. I'd be really p'd of if I was Ox . Sitting on bench game after game

representative_posts.author: bigsteviebhoy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: True, but he has been on a shocking decline over the last 12-18 months. He was every part the undroppable player for many years but he's not that player anymore. I'm not trying to bad mouth him, anything but. I just feel that he should have been phased out of starting every game.

representative_posts.author: quietnotabot.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Great player in his day but past it now, telling that nobody else was in for him. I hate it when Scottish teams go for washed up has beens, it never goes well and must be really dispiriting for young players trying to break through.

representative_posts.author: nickbaumgardner.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Two things are true for me: 1) Zero issue with Sam LaPorta voicing his frustration the Lions haven't extended him. Lions have extended guys with health concerns before, etc. I get that, it's his right and I agree with him. We cannot ask players to speak their mind and be mad when then do. (cont)

representative_posts.author: britainscot.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The trouble is most of the players brought in to effectively be first team players or that should step right in during a game haven't done very much to warrant them getting in the squad never mind starting a game, if we had a decent striker Wilson would be on the bench lets be honest.

representative_posts.author: grumpy-bob.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hard to evaluate at this stage but depends if he can be a reliable squad player this year as more bit part with piecemeal minutes. And if we can shift him for a decent fee while picking up an elite option at the end of the season.

representative_posts.author: jon-salt.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I know it's frustrating Martin, but we need to stick with it and give Glasner time. This is a significant change in system for the players. He's proven at multiple clubs that he can succeed. We need to get off the manager carousel at Forest and build something.

representative_posts.author: totalgarbodor.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The funny thing is he got injured when the Leafs have no choice but to play him bottom 6 as a winger… that’s the one thing he’s actually semi decent at lol

representative_posts.author: ajdunford.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: His runs are brainless, he’s a brainless player, he just runs forward. And he has no tricks, no particular passing ability and isn’t very good at crossing. Whisper it quietly but he is a much worse footballer than McNeil. Dibling should be well ahead of him in the pecking order

representative_posts.author: jamesaithie.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Trust me to pick out the player who is out due to an illness.

representative_posts.author: justdodgerolltv.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah, I went a bit bigger on it, mostly because right now it seems like players don't have outs for what I'm doing and also players are dropping Purulia because it does jack all against the chess boys. Alba Zoa is also a response to the chess boys.

perspectives.title: WWE Saudi Shows
perspectives.summary: WWE prioritizes profits over wrestler safety

representative_posts.author: mikedamark.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m not joking when I say anyone who goes to this show deserves whatever might happen to them There is no reason to go into a war zone for any job unless you are in the military If someone decides their job at wwe is so important that they won’t quit instead of going then whatever happens is on them

representative_posts.author: zestylantern264.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: #wrestlesky #prowrestling #aew Somewhere in the world, two big time pro-wrestlers are either wildly(or mildly) uncomfortable with the shipping together they're getting or they're planning a new angle on their vicious rivalry which, when seen, will send a huge wave of fans instantly to horny jail.

representative_posts.author: huggydave.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hope this serves as a chilling reminder to wrestlers and wrestling fans how WWE would rather see you die than miss a payday

representative_posts.author: zdoonaisback.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That would happen irl I'm a wrestler at heart

representative_posts.author: stholeary.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I don't think pro wrestling fans truly understand how much WWE *needs* these Saudi shows to happen. The blood money is propping up all their financials for Wall Street. There's no choice. If the money is there, execs will gladly risk the life of anyone on the roster. Chelsea Green? Expendable.

representative_posts.author: shintigercurl.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: there are other places they can go besides AEW. but unless that job is being a cop or a soldier or a firefighter where you risk your life to protect others, i'd go back to being a roofer. because being a wrestler isn't something worth dying for. especially not for a company like the E.

representative_posts.author: pierceah66.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: “Pro wrestler” is a bit charitable there when most people only remember who she is because she dated a convicted pedophile who still keeps getting paid by other pro wrestlers.

representative_posts.author: jamwa.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Wrestling was in pretty much the same boat for the longest time, especially if you were outside North America. Now there's so much wrestling made easily available online each week that we're drowning trying to keep up with it! 😄

representative_posts.author: jmargotcritch.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Finally watched this. Professional wrestling is just a beautiful thing.

representative_posts.author: sdmb1212.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Going backwards and using this to learn about pro-wrestling

representative_posts.author: parraseaux.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If there is one thing I know about wrestling, it’s that they know how to make a hit look far more painful than it is. They are true masters :)

representative_posts.author: daaaavveeee.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: In your opinion, what’s the funniest wrestling segment of all time?

representative_posts.author: thebue.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I wrestled from grade school through high school. Dabbled in Jiu jitsu and my wrestling foundation gave me a large advantage, so said the jits guys I rolled with. Collegiate and Olympic Wrestling is a martial art.

representative_posts.author: smolrobots.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And me and Phil got roped in because she knew fuck all about wrestling and didn't want to go on her own. So we just got to hang around while the boys were going through their spots for the matches beforehand. I saw Fleisch do his phoenix star press (springboard shooting star to the outside).

representative_posts.author: smolrobots.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That's also where I learned that the figure-four leg lock is just a resthold, because one of the guys put it on another and the "victim" started flailing aroung dramatically going, "Oh it's so stiff! It's so stiff!" (Stiff means painful if you don't know your wrestling jargon.)

representative_posts.author: fennygoldfish.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Wrestling. Don't forget the wrestling. Pa loved it, so we watched.

representative_posts.author: commandersterling.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Doing a wrestling in Salford today!

perspectives.title: Writing Struggles

representative_posts.author: electricsiren.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Calling all authors and fiction writers! As an avid reader who devours stories from every single genre, I want to fill my feed with your books. Let's connect! Pitch me your current project using only emojis, or drop the last sentence you wrote in your draft. Go! #BookSky #WritingCommunity #Writers

representative_posts.author: thefoliobridge.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Writers, remember: your first draft doesn't have to be perfect. It just has to exist. ✍️ What helps you keep writing when inspiration disappears? #WritingCommunity #AmWriting

representative_posts.author: samola99.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Dear writers, Your story doesn't have to be perfect to deserve to be read. Every beloved book started somewhere with a rough draft, an uncertain first chapter, or an idea that wouldn't leave its author's mind. Keep writing. #WritingCommunity #WritersOfBluesky #AmWriting

representative_posts.author: bringmayflowers.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I mean, not like I /will/.) or anything, I've been trying t get good at writing for the last twenty fucking years and the best thing I've ever made was thoroughly middling at best, so I dunno, I'm just r esigned to it I.guess

representative_posts.author: harperlcarnes.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is happening tomorrow and I’m so excited for novel writing month to begin!!! I’ll be working on book two of my series!!!

representative_posts.author: norsehound.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Having the interesting problem of *needing* to work on fanfiction but *wanting* to work on original writing.

representative_posts.author: samola99.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Writers, I have a question, What's harder for you? A. Writing the first chapter B. Getting through the middle C. Writing the ending D. Letting someone else read your work for the first time 😅 I want to hear your answers. #WritingCommunity #AmWriting #IndieAuthors

representative_posts.author: nils.readindiefantasy.com
representative_posts.text: I'm finally well enough to do a bit of writing. I'm on my own, and I've got plenty of time to write. No distractions. Time for doom scrolling!

representative_posts.author: eolaspellor.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Time ceases to exist, for one thing. I can write for yours and turn out 5000 or 6000 words a day. I can hear the characters telling me the story, and everything clicks. It may not all be brilliant writing, but at least it’s good enough to edit into a final form #PetendPanel.

representative_posts.author: sicstories.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Okay, lots of sleep later and I'm spooling back up to continue the writing marathon! The Stories So Far:

representative_posts.author: aetusart.com
representative_posts.text: Are you writing a book?

representative_posts.author: sularissax.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: wow, this writing is sort of abysmal dog shit though everyone just sort of says what they're thinking and exposits its constantly, also the pacing is ungood

representative_posts.author: deianestormborn.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And I'm so glad. About the writing. It means so much to me, thank you. I guess abandoning it for nearly a decade did create some insecurities. Or perhaps younger me was unapologetic when it came to my stories. Either way, I'm slowly getting there again. Thank you <3 I hope you'll enjoy TTATT too.

representative_posts.author: woodenvelt.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And I am going to keep chipping away at Demon in a Bottle because that world has my brain in it's grip. Unfortunately, this has been a terrible year for writing. There has been so much stress and chaos with our move (we are still in temporary housing) that I haven't had mental energy for writing.

representative_posts.author: sword-tree.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I love reading about writing and writing about reading that. scampering up and down game trails, pursued and pursuing, always relating but never touching, presence continually repositioned by mobile absence

representative_posts.author: pistorius.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sometimes I feel bad abt my writing but then I watch video essays on other books that are like super famous like 13 Reasons Why and I feel so much better because if *that* can receive 90000 awards. Then yeah. Yeah my writing possibly is enjoyable too

representative_posts.author: samundomiel.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: tbh I'm in journaling crisis over One Question: who am I writing for? am I writing to unravel my thoughts? am I writing to document my day for myself, a snapshot of my life at this time? am I writing for future historians who will coo over finding something after every hard drive has failed?

representative_posts.author: canuckuma.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I started writing a lot more for the first time in a long time this week~💕 Tying world building and lore from my worlds ancient past (which was the previous setting I focused on) to it’s cyberfantasy present 🥰💕 It’s been a fun exploration so far. Prompts are a great idea~

representative_posts.author: equitableforall.com
representative_posts.text: "﻿When I still worked as a psychotherapist, I ﻿often combined my personal insights about the catharsis of writing with my therapeutic lens, especially when employing a narrative therapy approach with trauma survivors."✍🏾 - Krystal Kavita Jagoo, MSW.

representative_posts.author: jcw.gay
representative_posts.text: To the people who are still hesitantly fans of Harry Potter... Might I genuinely, kindly, and without any internet-inherent sense of snark, suggest writing your own stories? For real, I used to be a huuuuuuge fan of ol' HP, but now that I've written my own worlds and stories? It's way better.

representative_posts.author: bubblewowie.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: i feel like my head has been encased in a fish bowl for months, like i already haven’t made any progress with drawing in multiple years but i feel like writing is getting harder too and i am stuck and losing the parts of myself i am proud of 💧💧💧 touhou sweat drops extreme edition

representative_posts.author: danjwrites.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I went to the bookshop this morning and didn't buy any books! If nothing else, it has most definitely given me some inspiration for the sorts of things that I would like to read next. But then I realised that I do actually have a lot of books at home that I still need to read. 😂 #writing #books

representative_posts.author: raininglamppost.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Writing has slowed down as there's a lot I simply haven't planned properly - but I've also started working on a side thing of making custom Vampire Survivors characters from Era's End Entities, LISA: The Downcast, EnHanced, FriendShapes and some Starfinder characters we made a while ago 🦇

representative_posts.author: kalsen.dk
representative_posts.text: The charitable read is that good writing is systemically undervalued by the people in charge of making decisions. Lots of good game writers out there, they just rarely get to flex their muscles.

representative_posts.author: azur-arathoul.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I already know some of your writing from Ao3 and absolutely love it. I’d be honored to read your book and give you some feedback.

representative_posts.author: jendiagammon.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So of course, I’m writing a spy thriller currently, on the side, as well as preparing to edit a spy thriller anthology!

representative_posts.author: hifuu.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: now that i'm older i can appreciate the writing in pmd explorers so much better. a respected member of a community doing something horrible to two kids, their fear of not being believed, the initial skepticism they're met with, the strength of their support network... it made me happy

representative_posts.author: writers-write.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 'Who wants to become a writer? And why? Because it’s the answer to everything. To Why am I here? To uselessness. It’s the streaming reason for living. To note, to pin down, to build up, to create, to be astonished at nothing.' ~Enid Bagnold #authorbirthday #writingsky #nationalvelvet

representative_posts.author: not-ni-theaters.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I don’t write with prompts and would consider anyone writing with prompts not a writer 🤷

representative_posts.author: lizhare.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Your writing on this topic over the years has been spot on. It has definitely influenced how I think about my work. ￼

representative_posts.author: jasoncolavito.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The feedback from publishers on my book proposal has been depressing. They absolutely love the topic and the book and think the writing is phenomenal, but they won't buy it because either (a) I am not famous enough to be allowed to write books or (b) I'm tainted by UFOs.

representative_posts.author: drsepinwall.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My first 12 pp. slap. Author #5 is fucking interesting as were her parents. Tomorrow I'll leave her parents behind & write about her romance with her future husband. There's a ton I need to say about their life in the Party, then their respective writing - hopefully I can make it less than 50 pp!!

representative_posts.author: krkampion.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Truly!! Between my writing and my toddler who outgrew naps the I've had to put the DMing side of my ttrpg hobby on hold, but one day I'll have the time again lol

representative_posts.author: radiumskull.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I went to art school, too! 😄 What the writing workshop confirmed for me was, not everybody will understand what I'm aiming for. Criticisms are there for me to accept or reject, depending on whether I think it will get me closer to my goal.

representative_posts.author: bobeaglestone.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It’s a good thing you write sf, you’d never cut it writing pantomimes.

representative_posts.author: tonybrichard.com
representative_posts.text: The Paths We Walk Junior Writing Contest Accepting 500-1,000-word submissions from writers 13-17 years old through October 31, 2026. Stories must use the provided image as a base and begin with "Along the path, I saw..."

perspectives.title: Restaurant Quality
perspectives.summary: Some restaurants are classy and fine dining

representative_posts.author: clearspies.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This place had a restaurant though.

representative_posts.author: underpantsgnome.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Any restaurant that has "factory" in the name is definitely not classy, fine dining

representative_posts.author: parisdog.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I found more than enough restaurants open for business

representative_posts.author: persian-slipper.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Ooh, which restaurant is this?

representative_posts.author: chadstanton.blacksky.app
representative_posts.text: Let’s go ahead and eliminate everyone living near a major metropolitan area. They have good restaurants out in the country too! Fancy ones!

representative_posts.author: brielikethechhes.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m curious. Did you get to try any restaurants on your trip?

representative_posts.author: aahabershaw.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: There is a certain magic to how every single hotel restaurant isn't good enough that you *want* to eat there, but yet they're never *bad* enough that you *won't* eat there at least once during your stay.

representative_posts.author: clofsnitville.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And this is the thing: having nicer casual restaurants to go to where you don't have to dress up and where kids are welcome and have a good kids menu to choose from *is a good thing* and it's an easy place for a family with different tastes to go as you say - options!

representative_posts.author: teapotorbit.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Who actually cares where they open a restaurant

representative_posts.author: neurosismancer.gay
representative_posts.text: i would never order from that restaurant again

representative_posts.author: kavi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Such a weird decision to specifically reference a restaurant with an extremely specific aesthetic, for no reason (it's not like TCF is some iconic Old Town Pasadena place, though it does exist there) and then not actually do the aesthetic

representative_posts.author: southernviolet.northsky.social
representative_posts.text: I dunno I see those in malls and business parks more tha highways. Some are pretty good. But Baltimore has so many good local restaurants that I don’t feel the need for the chains.

representative_posts.author: eanderson75.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Seeing more Asian and other ethnic supermarkets. Ditto with restaurants from countless cultures.

representative_posts.author: keakealani.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I believe you, but extremely can’t relate, having grown up in the land of incredible fusion restaurants and every possible type of Japanese food by the dozen. OTOH, Latin American food still hasn’t broken into the Hawaiʻi market and I’m not sure why.

representative_posts.author: laviezine.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: S.F.’s best new Thai restaurant pushes the boundaries of flavor The past couple years have been fruitful for Thai restaurants in the Bay Area, with numerous high-profile openings, especially in San …

representative_posts.author: jimrion.com
representative_posts.text: Tokyo people: are there any good taco/Mexican restaurants in simple reach of Jimbocho?

representative_posts.author: reasonabledoubt.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: One of the nicest restaurants in Ybor put hot dogs and burgers on the menu for all World Series games. So here I am a Flor Fina with other folks dressed for weddings and fundraisers in my Rocco Baldelli jersey.

representative_posts.author: truebluemajority.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: There is wider availability of high quality foreign beer and locally produced craft beer, not just in top level restaurants but also at the package store down the street

representative_posts.author: silverrain64.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Nonono, that's the sketchy restaurant with the broken sign in the run-down strip mall that every small town in America seems to have. This is a bit more... uh... Is "upscale" the right word?

representative_posts.author: bartlipman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I don’t remember the name but there was an excellent place out west around the shopping center in the early 80’s. Opened not much before the first Thai restaurant in town.

representative_posts.author: mimapleman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We can’t afford to go to a restaurant.

representative_posts.author: paul.ofthenorth.ca
representative_posts.text: They're being held up in closed restaurants?

representative_posts.author: eatthis.com
representative_posts.text: 5 Restaurant Chains With the Best Chicken and Waffles, According to Diners

representative_posts.author: lauraclawson.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: We ate at Californios years ago, when it had one star. It was an exceptional meal but what really stood out was how *nice* the staff were. Obviously obsequious service is a thing at Michelin-starred restaurants but this was different — unpretentious and specifically kind.

representative_posts.author: plumpallas.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I want restaurant breakfast so bad ouugh...that shit is Expensive - even moreso if you want it Actually Good - but ohugh fuck, man one of the best local places for it got bought out and turbo-bungled and I would genuinely kill for an egg sandwich that good again

representative_posts.author: liviohenrik.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is true. When I was a kid we had to travel out of our town to find a chinese restaurant. Mexican was sort of exotic. We'd take a trip to the Mall to get Mexican food. Taco Bell was also a big drive two towns over. I was from a small town but it was near major cities. Not rural country.

representative_posts.author: saltcreekbrews.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: There's a reason Gordon Ramsey uses their menu as a pejorative against restaurants with long menus on his restaurant salvation shows - he's not fixing a Cheesecake Factory so why does the menu look like one

representative_posts.author: stopcallingmefrank.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I visited this place. It’s a tourist attraction that can’t be too overt about the source of the attraction. There’s a restaurant, but it can’t have the obvious theme: No “der Führer’s Vegetarian Favorites” or “Eva Braunschweiger Sandwich.”

representative_posts.author: nerdyotto.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is also white people when they get the Fries and Coleslaw of top of their sandwich at the Pittsburgh Primanti Bros. Restaurant.

representative_posts.author: danrofohio.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I have been in many Chinese restaurants, but I have never been in one without artwork depicting Chinese scenes. I only cared about the quality of the food.

representative_posts.author: gamerstavernshow.com
representative_posts.text: I remember when sushi was dismissively called "bait". The exoticism of McDonald's offering sweet and sour dipping sauce for their Chicken McNuggets with chopsticks to eat them with. The only delivery food options in most areas was pizza. Even Chinese restaurants in a lot of areas didn't deliver.

representative_posts.author: very-simple.com
representative_posts.text: Also, like many of these chain restaurants (including ones I have deep nostalgic affection for - remember Bennigans?), the walls are absolutely covered in tchotchkes from top to bottom, which I’m pretty sure is the joke.

representative_posts.author: snufkinlib.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I understand it in small restaurants with limited capacity. This place was the size of an airplane hangar and there was still a giant line!

representative_posts.author: notrebecca.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This must play well to the rubes who have never been to a fancy restaurant.

representative_posts.text: From Parisian Sweets To Pizzerias: 8 New Restaurants In Abu Dhabi This October Abu Dhabi’s dining scene has something new for every craving this October, whether you’re in the mood …

representative_posts.text: As someone who used to work in restaurants… I know that feeling when you see something about the spill.

Culture.name: First Cinema Experience

perspectives.title: First Cinema Memory
perspectives.summary: People share their first cinema experience

representative_posts.author: tomewing.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Genuinely can’t remember, sorry cinephiles. I know where it would have been - Saturday matinee at the Thorndike Theatre Leatherhead which doubled as a cinema for the kids, probably in 78 or 79. But whatever it was it instilled in me a lifelong broad apathy about the movies!

representative_posts.author: janehill.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Other than Saturday morning cinema, the first one I really remember is Snowball Express, 1972, at the Odeon on the corner of Festing Road in Southsea. Lovely cinema, still feel angry whenever I revisit my old haunts that it’s no longer there.

representative_posts.author: dasmunch.eurosky.social
representative_posts.text: Disney's Robin Hood at the Sheppey Cinema. I must have been five. I remember being hugely jealous later that year because my friend James went to the Cannon cinema in Sittingbourne to see Back To The Future

representative_posts.author: centuriesofsound.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I was definitely taken to the cinema as a small child, most likely to see Disney classics, but do I remember any? No, I do not.

representative_posts.author: bexxi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: First film you saw at the cinema. The real first one, not the pretend one you tell people! Film, year, where, & whatever stuck with you. The Slipper & the Rose. Commodore, Aberystwyth, 1976. I remember NOTHING except that Dad took me; it might be the only time we ever went to the cinema together.

representative_posts.author: starstormx1.eurosky.social
representative_posts.text: ...dangit, I was taken to my first movie theater WAY too young to remember anything! Well, aside from the Cineplex Odeon presentation package at the time. Had some vague memories of them that got reignited watching uploads and realizing "oh yeah, I think I saw this"

representative_posts.author: bringthenoise.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: First NEW film I remember was Suburban Commando at the same cinema in 1991. A rare cinema outing for my Dad, we were sent out to clear the house for my Mum to run a Tupperware party. I think I enjoyed the big promotional cup with straw I was bought more than the movie.

representative_posts.author: careyart.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sleeping Beauty, 1972, probably the Odeon Cinema Brighton. I'd have been around 4 and the only memory I have is also one of my earliest memories, which is being absolutely terrified of Maleficient as the dragon at the end. Gave me nightmares for years after

representative_posts.author: twofatfeet.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: If you ignore the Saturday morning kids’ programmes, the first time I remember going to the cinema would have either been a cartoon version of Alice in Wonderland or Candleshoe. At least one of those would have been in 1977 because there were posters for Star Wars and I wanted to see that instead

representative_posts.author: merseytart.com
representative_posts.text: Snow White, 1980, cinema in Bury Park, Luton. I was three and my mum worried I’d fidget and get bored. Instead I sat absolutely rapt and didn’t move an inch. It was, after all, a big telly.

representative_posts.author: richard0x4a.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think it was The Dark Crystal, at Ripon Cinema, probably in 1982 when I was 7. I can remember my Grandma getting so thoroughly involved in the film that she called out "Fly!" at some key moment in the middle of the cinema. Great film.

representative_posts.author: qbajjarandlampuki.bsky.social

perspectives.summary: Smoking is no longer allowed in many public spaces

representative_posts.author: mahelious.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I do not miss the smoking sections of restaurants or hotels. If you were in the first booth of the "non-smoking" section it was guaranteed that food would taste like cigarette ash.

representative_posts.author: dixonij.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The utter obliteration of smoking sections in restaurants when people started taking secondhand smoke damage seriously in the early 2000's

representative_posts.author: holyshitimfucked.com
representative_posts.text: It happened on a generational divide. Young smokers just started going outside to smoke. Don't know if it was carryover from smoking being disallowed in restaurants and workplaces.

representative_posts.author: ppu512.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Im old enough to remember going to restaurants with smoking sections, and my dad was a smoker, and my clothes would stink like a tobacco and tar bonfire by the end of every visit with him. Vaping, at least, doesn't get into your hair and clothes like that.

representative_posts.author: sergalprojects.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: On that note, everyone ever notice how much *better* everything smells in public spaces after the smoking bans?

representative_posts.author: awfullyvague.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: (Lack of) smoking. We made ashtrays for our parents in art class and no one thought this was the tiniest bit strange. In California you can only smoke in designated areas and most of those are in Nevada. It's great.

representative_posts.author: doronjosama.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I misread this at first as a Beavis & Butthead style "Smoking rules!" statement, but figured it out pretty quick. 😅 And yes, everyone smoked everywhere in public with scant regard for who was around. Many of my elementary school friends had scars from walking into a lit cigarette held at kid-level.

representative_posts.author: kayorchison.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: There was a smoking section on a 747 I was on as a kid. There was a smoking section on a fkn COACH with sealed windows. "Section" You know a plane has been around for a while when you find ashtrays in the armrests.

representative_posts.author: woozle2023.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Smoking eliminated in restaurants and other public spaces. Seat belt requirements and car seats for babies & children.

representative_posts.author: stephenjwild.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: In my early 20s I worked in a bar that still permitted smoking. It was gross (but paid well). We have come far (laudatory).

representative_posts.author: emmalufc.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah as a family we used to sit in the smoking section so my dad could have a cigar. He wouldn't dream of doing the same to my kids. Times have changed for the better

representative_posts.text: This. People today could never imagine sitting in a restaurant next to a guy that puts his cigarette out in his mashed potatoes. Or sitting in a 'no smoking row' on an airplane where 50 people have lit up. Or having your doctor come into the exam room smoking.

representative_posts.author: civ5fan.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Not having smoking in restaurants.

representative_posts.author: justbru.ce.it

representative_posts.author: brianbo.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Uh, what type of smoking?

perspectives.title: Bike Safety

representative_posts.text: I love this genre of newspaper articles. The I got my fat arse into a car and drove around the cycle lanes are empty. Well if you put your fat slobby self on a bike they wouldn't be would they. Bike lanes are worth it just for the annoyance they cause drivers

representative_posts.author: altimeter3835.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yeah, see? That's why everyone else hates bike people...

representative_posts.author: notdanish.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Nobody rides bikes in Iowa, it's not like it's a totally flat state like the Netherlands.

representative_posts.author: realitydame.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Aside from the 20% in Iowa that probably do ride bikes and care about their health, the remaining are obese, red necks who drink natural ice and chain smoke cigarettes so I guess it tracks 🤷‍♀️

representative_posts.author: cycleislington.uk
representative_posts.text: Riding a bike still does feel like freedom - especially where infrastructure keeps cars/vans/hgvs/suvs separate. Carry on campaigning, people on bikes, for people who would love to be on bikes

representative_posts.author: jdlevato.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: what's absolutely insane about this, after a recent visit to IA, bike lanes are the only form of infrastructure they have.

representative_posts.text: People not riding bikes in Iowa ragbrai.com

representative_posts.author: mpoessel.de
representative_posts.text: I've heard as criticism that the bike-friendly environment is restricted to Paris proper, benefiting the city dwellers but not the (systematically less affluent) people in the surrounding region.

representative_posts.text: They’re also doing a zombie bike ride & barcrawl tonight lol 🧟‍♂️ We kept seeing people in costume ride by & figured it out! No matter what this govt says, cities & towns across the country know bikes & transit make cities more livable & fun 🎃🚲🚋

representative_posts.author: viamarsala18.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’ve never biked that intersection but I drive it a lot and I have seen many many shady car vs bike situations.

representative_posts.author: rickcrawf.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Paris is now so bike orientated. Way more than London. I don't know how much this was regional as opposed to local government action, but the cycle trips will be mostly local.
